summary.intent: Deploy v0.25.0 to staging after merging the release PR, and fix a broken Docker image build that was blocking the staging deployment pipeline.
summary.outcome: Identified that the Tag Staging Release action is the correct manual trigger for staging deploys. Fixed a stale `packages/crypto` COPY in the API Dockerfile that was causing build failures, committed as `fix(ci)` to trigger a v0.25.1 patch release via release-please.

repo: Staging deployment is intentionally manual: requires running the 'Tag Staging Release' GitHub Actions workflow with a version input, which runs E2E tests, waits for approval, creates a `v*-staging-rc-*` tag, and triggers deploy.
The deploy-staging.yml workflow triggers on tags matching `v*-staging*`, not on release tags directly.
release-please creates release tags (e.g. v0.25.0) automatically on release PR merge, but only `feat` and `fix` commit types trigger a new release PR/version bump — `chore` does not.
The API is a zero-knowledge server that never handles plaintext or encryption — it stores opaque blobs, manages auth, and proxies IPFS, so it has no workspace package dependencies.
The api-client is generated from the API's OpenAPI spec via `pnpm api:generate`, acting as the typed bridge between the API and client apps without shared code dependencies.
Tag Staging Release checks out the release tag's commit, so Dockerfile fixes must be in a new tagged release (v0.25.1) to take effect — patching main alone is insufficient.

code.finding: Had a stale `COPY packages/crypto/package.json` that didn't correspond to any actual API dependency. With an expanded pnpm workspace package list, this caused `pnpm deploy` to fail trying to resolve `@cipherbox/core` (a dependency of `@cipherbox/crypto`) which wasn't in the build context. Fix: remove the stale COPY.

workflow: When a Docker build uses `pnpm deploy --filter @cipherbox/app`, all workspace packages referenced in the lockfile (even transitively via devDependencies) need their package.json present in the build context.
Use `fix(ci)` instead of `chore(ci)` for broken build fixes when a new release tag is needed — chore commits are ignored by release-please.

friction: User forgot about the manual 'Tag Staging Release' action, expecting staging to auto-deploy on release tag creation.
The stale `packages/crypto` COPY in the Dockerfile was a latent bug that only surfaced when the pnpm workspace package list was expanded, making it hard to trace back to root cause.
The Tag Staging Release action's dependency on the release tag commit means CI fixes require a full new patch release cycle rather than just merging to main.
open_items: v0.25.1 patch release needs to complete via release-please after the fix(ci) commit merges, then Tag Staging Release must be re-run with v0.25.1 to complete the staging deployment.
Consider auditing other app Dockerfiles in the monorepo for similarly stale workspace package COPY statements.
Consider whether staging should auto-deploy on release tags (adding `v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+` pattern to deploy-staging.yml triggers) rather than requiring manual workflow dispatch.
